rows.label: qst660104_msg0001
rows.name:
Wow! Your world sounds way
different from Alst, Shulk.
I can't even imagine!

rows.label: qst660104_msg0002
rows.name:
I think our worlds have much in common
too. It's fascinating...

rows.label: qst660104_msg0003
rows.name:
Now that we've exchanged information,
we should investigate this place next.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0004
rows.name:
Hm. Not that there's
much to see here...

rows.label: qst660104_msg0005
rows.name:
Shulk, Fiorung, have you
guys been here before?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0006
rows.name: No, never.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0007
rows.name:
Fiorung and I were out walking when
we found a strange light... a portal.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0008
rows.name:
Shulk couldn't resist his curiosity
and went right up to it.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0009
rows.name: Sorry, sorry...

rows.label: qst660104_msg0010
rows.name:
What happened to us
was fairly similar.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0011
rows.name:
Tora couldn't resist his curiosity
either, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0012
rows.name: Rex went first, though.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0014
rows.name:
So the portal you came through
is over there somewhere?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0015
rows.name: What about the portal you used?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0016
rows.name: It's over there.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0017
rows.name: You can't see anything, right?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0018
rows.name: Yeah.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0019
rows.name: I suspected as much...

rows.label: qst660104_msg0020
rows.name:
Each of us can only see the portal
that we ourselves passed through.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0021
rows.name:
We can't go where you came from, Rex,
and you can't go where we came from.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0022
rows.name: So we can only meet here?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0023
rows.name: It seems that way.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0024
rows.name:
So... do we just chat and have fun
here, mo?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0025
rows.name: Ooh, shall I prepare some snacks?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0026
rows.name:
Sounds good. I'd like to try
the snacks Homura makes.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0027
rows.name: That would be a problem, mo...

rows.label: qst660104_msg0028
rows.name: Who's there?!

rows.label: qst660104_msg0029
rows.name: The voice came from above!

rows.label: qst660104_msg0030
rows.name: Over here too.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0031
rows.name: When did you get here?!

rows.label: qst660104_msg0032
rows.name: Easy for the Nopon Great Sage, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0033
rows.name: Who exactly are you...?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0034
rows.name:
The Nopon Great Sage is a great Nopon
who trained across every place and age
to become a great sage, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0035
rows.name:
Even so, you look younger
than Tora, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0036
rows.name: What a rude Nopon, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0037
rows.name:
Despite appearances, Nopon Great Sage
has lived about 100 million times
longer than Tora, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0038
rows.name: A hundred million? I'm not buying it.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0039
rows.name:
You don't have to believe me, but
if I say this place was made by
Nopon Great Sage, you'll have to, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0040
rows.name: You made this place?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0041
rows.name: Ahem, mo!

rows.label: qst660104_msg0042
rows.name: But whatever for?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0043
rows.name:
So I can watch you overcome
the seemingly impossible challenges
Nopon Great Sage prepared, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0044
rows.name: He means to test our mettle, then...?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0045
rows.name: What a strange hobby...

rows.label: qst660104_msg0046
rows.name: You could call it bad taste.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0047
rows.name: Mo-mo?! That's uncalled for, mo...

rows.label: qst660104_msg0048
rows.name:
If there's a reward, Tora doesn't mind
taking the challenge, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0049
rows.name: But of course!

rows.label: qst660104_msg0050
rows.name:
Clear the challenges, and I'll give
you something good based on your
results, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0051
rows.name:
Can Tora get a Super Tropical
Sweet-Sweet Wiener, mo?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0052
rows.name:
That didn't taste good, so I didn't
stock up, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0053
rows.name:
Mo-mo?! Tora just made that up.
It really exists, mo?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0054
rows.name:
Instead, I have lots of items
that are very hard to get, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0055
rows.name: Sounds fun, doesn't it, Meleph?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0056
rows.name:
I'd be lying if I said
I wasn't curious...

rows.label: qst660104_msg0057
rows.name: Then shall we try?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0058
rows.name:
Shulk-san, Fiorung-san,
what will you do?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0059
rows.name:
Reyn would probably stop me,
but I'm for it.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0060
rows.name:
I want to do something fun with
the friends we just met.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0061
rows.name:
If Fiorung's up for it,
I'll join in too.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0062
rows.name: Yay, mo!

rows.label: qst660104_msg0063
rows.name:
Things work differently here than
in our world, so we'll fight while
supporting Rex and the others.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0064
rows.name: Right.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0065
rows.name:
And it seems we can summon
our weapons freely—like Blades
in your world.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0066
rows.name: That's reassuring.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0067
rows.name: It sounds fun to team up with Fiorung.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0068
rows.name: Look forward to it!

rows.label: qst660104_msg0069
rows.name:
When you're ready, talk to
the Nopon Great Sage, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0070
rows.name: Then the Challenge Battle begins, mo!

rows.label: qst660104_msg0110
rows.name:
It was much the same for Hana
and the others, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0111
rows.name:
Tora couldn't resist his curiosity
either, mo.

rows.label: qst660104_msg0112
rows.name:
Wasn't it Rex, not Master,
who went first, mo?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0128
rows.name: Who's there?!

rows.label: qst660104_msg0144
rows.name: So you want to test our skills...?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0155
rows.name: Tora wants to try, mo!

rows.label: qst660104_msg0156
rows.name:
I'm a bit curious myself. Rex,
don't you think we should try it?

rows.label: qst660104_msg0157
rows.name:
Yeah... I think I'd like
to try the challenge.
